Description: Defeat bosses across Tamriel. You can find these enemies in arenas, delves, dungeons, incursions, trials, and more!
Revive players by using a soul gem to complete this activity. Reviving yourself does not count towards this goal.
Destroy Dark Anchors sent to Tamriel by Molag Bal.
Achieve victory in public dungeon group events.
Complete Normal or Veteran Group Dungeons throughout Tamriel.
